title: Cordially,
body:
God Spreads Out
black veil
and the sky goes out
of the stars the light
around your face.

Slowly leaning
towards my shoulder
and tenderly,
a little timidly,
sing to your tune
ilove you.

It's your voice, honey
that pushes me to find
what my heart desires,
what he keeps hidden.

It's your two eyes
that keep me alive
in the spindles of time,
in the empty life.

Your kiss is sweet,
that haunts my mind
that unlocks tracks
of my tender self.

It's your two lips,
that seal me in yesterday.
Where it forgets to rise,
where the silences speak.

God Spreads Out
black veil
and the sky goes out
of the stars the light
around your face.

Slowly leaning
towards my shoulder
and tenderly,
a little timidly,
sing to your tune
ilove you.
